svg.text: SiLU + LayerNorm + Dropout 0.02 between linear layers
shared trunk: ID predicts Δu (4-D), FD predicts [Δx, Δxdot, ΔΔp] (12-D)
gray fan lines = full connectivity between adjacent layers; colored slabs = distinct feature groups in the 24-D input,
in the style of the multi-feature input stacks used by Liu et al. (2025) for hydraulic-manipulator dynamics networks.
